source.description: Third immutable synthetic calendar revision adds bounded historical-fee test sessions while preserving V1.3 and 2024 sessions; not an exchange calendar

semantics.timezone: Market-local session dates; release occurs only at each listed settlement session start using the injected Run Clock
semantics.prices: Not a price dataset; settlement dates are explicit synthetic fixture facts

sessions.calendar: Three bounded synthetic session segments with explicit unsupported gaps; not an exchange calendar

qualityCases: same calendar version asserted per settlement
unsupported gaps between fixture segments fail closed

expectedAssertions.description: CN_A and US_EQUITY have independent explicit session mappings and currency identity
A Friday settlement maps only to the explicitly listed Monday fixture session
A fixture-tail session without a settlement date retains a pending receivable
Dates outside the frozen fixture fail with SETTLEMENT_CALENDAR_UNAVAILABLE rather than deriving a date
